title: 我是卖艺不卖身的宁死不从惊你叫操蛋
content_zh:
我是卖艺不卖身的，宁死不从。
御圣君正欲弯身下去扶起凤蝶舞时，凤蝶舞少许惊恐的眼神看他一眼，立即起身，捂住手臂转身跑掉了，跑出了三四米远的距离便回头看了御圣君一眼，这一眼，流露出了她女儿家的心事。
凤蝶舞本有着倾国倾城，国色天香之色，凤眸一回，在御圣君眼中，刻下了回眸一笑百媚生之韵。
看着远去的倩影，御圣君始终收不回视线，尽管那抹身影早以消失于他漆黑的眸中。
御子尘看出御圣君的神态有不舍之意，嘴角不禁扬起自信的弧度，薄唇轻启前，嘴角的弧度消失，“皇兄，您在看什么呢？”
倏然间，御圣君眸子中那一丝复杂的情绪被他掩藏掉，淡道：“没什么，我们去其他地方看看/吧！”
“嗯，”御子尘轻应，随即尾随御圣君身后重新走起路来，只是这会在御圣君身后竟露出了平时少有的奸诈笑容，心想，御圣君一定是被凤蝶舞的一撞，以及那一记回眸，给乱了心神。能乱御圣君心神的，除了贪官污吏，便是女人了。
看来这俩人，有戏！
也不知跑了多久，直到筋疲力尽，地痞倒在了一条死胡同里。他以为死胡同唐琳不会找得到，岂料他正在吐舌头大口喘息时，唐琳脸不红气不喘走到了他面前，清爽干净的五官，始终挂着令人如沐春风般的笑意，“你好，钱袋可以还给我了吗？”
地痞一瞧清楚是唐琳，顿时五官挤在了一块，乖乖把钱袋给替出去，“女侠，您好样的，我服了，拿去吧，我没力气再跑了！”
“这还差不多，”地痞的妥协，让唐琳有了一丝好感，她拿过地痞手中的钱袋，翻开看了看，只有十多个铜板。
地痞恢复了一些体力，站起来，凑近唐琳，仔细打量起她的军装，她的军帽，她的军靴，以及她干净秀气，眉目如画的脸，忍不住大赞，“我说女侠，您到底何方仙女呀？瞧您这穿的，戴的，呵呵，多么与众不同。”刚要伸手去碰碰唐琳的衣服时，手被唐琳拍掉。
唐琳愠怒的神色看着他，“别多手，站开点！”
“是！”地痞重重应一声，有唐琳以前在教官面前发出的声音那么有力量，然后听她的话，乖乖站开了点，但欣赏她的神色始终没有褪去，“嘻嘻，女侠，您真好看，尤其是穿上这衣服，尤为精神！”
唐琳瞪他一眼，“少贫嘴，”随即，围着地痞转了一圈，犀利的目光一直在打量着地痞。
嗯，五官俊朗，不错。身高到位，身板挺直，有可塑性。声音有力量，除了痞了些，面目还是很佳的。能让她追了如此之久，耐力不错，跑功也不错。
地痞被她打量得毛骨悚然，忍不住搓了搓毛发竖起的手臂，视线一直在防着唐琳，“女侠，钱袋我已经还给您了，您还想怎样？”
唐琳白他一眼，“又不是要吃了你，你害怕什么？”
偏偏这会，她的目光，落在了他的脖子上。
地痞立即双手交叉，遮住自己的胸部，挑起嘴，拖了一个长音，“咦，您那什么目光？怎么感觉我是你的下酒菜似的，我告诉你，我是卖艺不卖身的，宁死不从，女侠你功夫再高，也强迫不了我！”
content_en:
I'm a prostitute, not a prostitute, and I'd rather die than obey.
When Yushengjun was about to bend down to help Fengdiewu, Fengdiewu looked at him with a slightly frightened look, immediately got up, covered her arms, turned around and ran away. After running three or four meters away, she looked back at Yushengjun. This glance revealed her daughter's thoughts.
The dance of the phoenix butterfly originally had the color that would captivate the country, the beauty of the country, and the fragrance of the heavens. Once the phoenix eyes turned around, it engraved the charm of looking back, smiling, and charming in the eyes of the Royal Saint.
Looking at the distant figure, Yu Shengjun could not take his eyes back, even though the figure had long since disappeared in his dark eyes.
Yu Zichen saw the reluctance in Yu Shengjun's expression, and the corners of his mouth could not help but raise a confident arc. Before opening his thin lips, the arc at the corners of his mouth disappeared, "Brother Emperor, what are you looking at?"
Suddenly, the complicated emotions in Yu Shengjun's eyes were hidden by him, and he said calmly: "It's nothing, let's go and see other places!"
"Yes," Yu Zichen responded lightly, and then followed Yu Shengjun and started walking again. However, at this moment, Yu Shengjun showed a rare treacherous smile behind him. He thought to himself that Yu Shengjun must have been disturbed by Fengdie Wu's bump and that look back. Apart from corrupt officials, the only people who can mess up the emperor's mind are women.
It seems that these two people have something to play for!
I don't know how long he ran until he was exhausted and fell into a dead end. He thought that Tang Lin would not find the dead end, but unexpectedly, when he was sticking out his tongue and gasping for breath, Tang Lin walked up to him without blushing and out of breath, with fresh and clean facial features and a smile that made people feel like spring breeze. "Hello, can you return the money bag to me?"
As soon as the ruffian saw that it was Tang Lin, his features immediately crowded together, and he obediently took the money bag out and said, "Xia, you're doing well. I'm convinced. Take it, I don't have the strength to run away anymore!"
"That's pretty much it." The gangster's compromise made Tang Lin feel good about it. She took the money bag from the gangster's hand, opened it and looked at it. There were only more than ten copper coins.
The ruffian regained some strength, stood up, came close to Tang Lin, and carefully looked at her military uniform, her military cap, her military boots, and her clean, delicate and picturesque face. He couldn't help but praise, "Say, Heroine, what kind of fairy are you? Look at what you are wearing, haha, how unique." Just when he was about to reach out to touch Tang Lin's clothes, Tang Lin slapped his hand away.
Tang Lin looked at him with a sullen expression, "Don't hold your hands too much, stand back!"
"Yes!" The ruffian responded with a strong voice, as powerful as the voice Tang Lin used to make in front of the instructor. Then he listened to her words and stood up obediently, but his admiration for her never faded. "Hehe, Heroine, you are so beautiful, especially in this dress, you look so energetic!"
Tang Lin glared at him and said, "Don't talk too much." Then she circled around the gangster, looking at him with sharp eyes.
Well, he has handsome features, not bad. The height is in place, the body is straight and flexible. The voice is powerful, and apart from being a bit arrogant, the appearance is still very good. It allowed her to chase for such a long time, with good endurance and good running skills.
The ruffian was horrified by her assessment. He couldn't help but rub his bristled arms, his eyes always guarding Tang Lin. "Hero, I've returned the money bag to you. What else do you want?"
Tang Lin rolled her eyes at him, "I'm not going to eat you, what are you afraid of?"
But at this moment, her eyes fell on his neck.
The gangster immediately crossed his hands to cover his chest, raised his mouth, and said in a long voice, "Hey, what's that look in your eyes? Why do you feel like I'm your food? Let me tell you, I'm a performer, not a prostitute. I'd rather die than obey. No matter how good your skills are, you can't force me!"
